=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: prompts/mode-implement.txt
  Line or code reference: lines 35-43 (new hardcoded block) and line 128 ({{REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_LOOP}})
  Problem: The PR adds a hardcoded "Verification loop:" block that duplicates and conflicts with the canonical reference rendered at line 128 from prompts/references/verification-loop.txt. The implement-phase model will receive two competing sets of verification instructions in the same rendered prompt with no priority rule.
  Why it fails at runtime: Three concrete conflicts exist. (1) Stage order: the new block specifies typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build, while the reference file specifies typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build -> smoke — the smoke stage is omitted. (2) Restart semantics: the new block says "If any stage fails, fix that stage and restart the verification loop from the beginning," while the reference says "Stop at the first failing tier, fix that tier, then continue only after it passes." (3) Completeness checks: the reference's grounding rule ("Ground every factual claim in repository evidence you actually read") and output-matching rule ("Before finishing, make sure the on-disk result matches what you report") are absent from the new block. The model has no priority rule to resolve these conflicts and may skip stages, restart unnecessarily, or omit grounding checks.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 40-53 (MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY_BLOCK variable and legacy sentinel comment removed) and line 127 (append_render_var "MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY" call removed)
  Problem: The PR removes MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY placeholder plumbing from the shell render script. While functionally safe at this moment — no prompt templates under prompts/ contain {{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}} (verified via grep across the entire prompts/ directory) — this is an out-of-scope change that alters the render pipeline without issue authorization. The removal is not required for the verification-loop task and was not in the issue's files_touched scope.
  Why it fails at runtime: If a future prompt template re-adds {{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}, the placeholder would now render unresolved because the shell-side --var injection was removed and the Python renderer's collect_legacy_env_values() only covers WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION, SEMBLE_PREFETCH, and SERENA_TOOL_HINTS — MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY is not in the legacy-collect set and is not in any mode contract.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "Update only prompts/mode-implement.txt to implement item 4 from docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md only." Issue files_touched lists only "prompts/mode-implement.txt". Issue says "Do not bundle item 5 guardrail bullets into this PR." and "The new text is additive and limited to item 4; validate-phase prompts remain untouched."
  Expected change site: Only prompts/mode-implement.txt should be modified.
  Evidence of absence: scripts/render_prompt.sh is modified — 9 lines removed for MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY plumbing — despite not being in files_touched or the item-4 scope. .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt is also modified, adding entries for prompts/overlays/*.txt files and analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-18.md, outside scope. Neither file is named in the issue's files_touched, scope, or acceptance criteria.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "The implement prompt names the four verification stages in order." The canonical reference at prompts/references/verification-loop.txt already names typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build -> smoke (five stages). The new block names only four stages (drops smoke), creating a conflict rather than resolving one.
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-implement.txt — either the new block should align with the reference's five-stage order, or the reference should be updated to the four-stage order and the new block should be removed in favor of the updated reference.
  Evidence of absence: The reference file still says "typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build -> smoke" (five stages including smoke). The new hardcoded block says "typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build" (four stages, no smoke). If the intent is four stages as the acceptance criteria states, the reference at prompts/references/verification-loop.txt was not updated to match, leaving the two sources in conflict.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: prompts/mode-implement.txt
  Line: 35-43
  Problem: The new hardcoded "Verification loop:" block duplicates and conflicts with the existing `{{REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_LOOP}}` placeholder at line 128. The reference file (prompts/references/verification-loop.txt) specifies order `typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build -> smoke` with restart semantics of "stop at first failing tier, fix that tier, then continue", while the new block specifies order `typecheck -> lint -> tests -> build` (no smoke) with restart semantics of "restart the verification loop from the beginning". This creates two competing verification contracts in the same prompt with different stage orders and different failure-recovery behavior.
  Why it fails at runtime: The implement-phase model receives conflicting instructions about verification order (with/without smoke) and conflicting restart semantics. It may follow either instruction non-deterministically, potentially skipping the smoke stage or restarting unnecessarily, leading to incomplete verification or wasted cycles.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Problem: The `{{REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_LOOP}}` placeholder remains unresolved in the same file after the new block was added, creating redundant verification instructions.

  SEVERITY: MAJOR
